purpose: Test the smallest remaining task-side semantic premise: an unchanged text fragment supports one natural entity query but is irrelevant to another. Not quantum identification, performance or a selected method.

source.identity_reference: R44 aggregate-only audited task; no valid/test access

sampling.eligibility: All exact original-token groups with>=2distinct ordered(subject_span,object_span) queries; ignore label values entirely for selection, including mixed-label eligibility.
sampling.group_key:
SHA256(UTF8(qattn-evidence-ownership-v1
)+UTF8(canonical JSON original tokens, ensure_ascii=True,separators=comma/colon)); break hash ties by canonical tokens.
sampling.query_choice: First two lexicographically ordered unique(subject_start,subject_end,object_start,object_end) tuples; no sampling by label, label difference, model outcome, annotatability or desired evidence.
sampling.no_rescue: Preserve every selected group including ambiguity/insufficient context, no replacement or larger sample to force a positive. Record any known historical exposure; no exclusion by its outcome.
sampling.source_identity_check: Hash all source bytes and58465rows while streaming; parsing consumes source containing train labels but selector must never consult or export label values. Do not describe byte consumption as no training-label access.

blinding.reader_inputs: Exact unchanged original tokens plus two natural span queries, opaque deterministic group/query IDs and fixed annotation instructions. No original example labels, predictions, model scores, prior32pool or mixed-label stratum information.
blinding.private_location: Exact owner attempt-scoped private output; no raw snippets/pack/IDs or annotation text in public Git/consultation packet. Only aggregate/hash protocol receipts collected publicly.
blinding.reader_independence: Two separately bounded readers submit without seeing each other; implementation must resolve suitable reader authority and privacy before launch. Do not send raw data to external model consultation transports. Human adjudication is required before treating model-only agreement as gold evidence.

per_query: supported: one or more explicit relationship-evidence token intervals beyond entity identities alone
annotation.guidance: Use text and resolved references only, no world-knowledge label guessing or assumed inverse relation. Allow multiple/discontinuous spans and uncertain status. At most one concise evidence-linked justification per judgment; no private chain-of-thought.
annotation.agreement: Preserve both raw judgments privately; report group-level ownership agreement, disagreements, uncertain/missing units and descriptive span overlap. Never force agreement through repeated annotation.

gates.before_extraction: Exact frozen source/contract/output allowlist, memory/privacy review, one bounded lifecycle canary, project-authorized shared-scheduler admission; no direct scientific SSH. Existing controller/node capacity unchanged.
gates.before_readers: Validate selected IDs/spans, private pack hash and label/prediction blinding; freeze reader prompt/identity and authority; no messaging or external raw-data transfer.
gates.premise_status: At least one unambiguous ownership-switch group agreed by both readers is only a finite diagnostic witness; otherwise close this32group probe as no_supported_witness, not population impossibility. Model-only agreement is provisional regardless of count.
gates.after_positive: Require a separate nontrivial full40class signed-margin prediction against entity-aware classical controls before any model job. No quantum distinction, generalization or L5 follows from annotation alone.

retention: Public Git contains design/code/source IDs and compact aggregate/hash reports. Raw text is a rebuildable private cache; never upload checkpoints/caches for this design. Decide minimal retention of new irreplaceable annotations by future consumer and privacy before publication; no COS operation now.
